evals.prompt: 帮我总结这篇飞书文档的要点：https://example.feishu.cn/docx/AbCdEfGhIjKl。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Fetch the document with docs +fetch as the user, then summarize from the fetched content.
expectations: Uses lark-cli docs +fetch with the document URL or token
Uses --as user for the document operation
Summarizes only after fetching instead of guessing the content

evals.prompt: Make a copy of the doc https://example.feishu.cn/docx/QwErTyUiOp called "Q3 plan (copy)". List the lark-cli commands you would run in order (placeholders are fine) and what each step is for.
evals.expected_output: Copy with lark-cli drive files copy, not by fetching the body and creating a new document.
expectations: Routes the copy to lark-drive and uses lark-cli drive files copy
Does not rebuild the document with docs +fetch followed by docs +create

evals.prompt: 把文档 https://example.feishu.cn/wiki/ZxCvBnMlKj 里『风险』一节改写得更简洁，其他部分不要动。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Fetch the relevant section, then edit it with docs +update following the update reference, leaving other sections unchanged.
expectations: Locates the target section (for example with +fetch and a section or keyword scope) before editing
Keeps the rest of the document unchanged

evals.prompt: Insert the local image ./diagrams/arch.png at the end of the doc https://example.feishu.cn/docx/PlMoKnIjUh. List the lark-cli commands you would run in order (placeholders are fine) and what each step is for.
evals.expected_output: Use docs +media-insert with the image referenced as @./diagrams/arch.png.
expectations: Uses docs +media-insert to insert the local image
References the local file inside the working directory with the @./relative path form

evals.prompt: 这篇文档昨天被误改了，帮我回滚到昨天上午的版本：https://example.feishu.cn/docx/HgFdSaQwEr。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: List document history, choose the version from yesterday morning, revert it and check the revert status.
expectations: Lists versions with docs +history-list before reverting
Reverts with docs +history-revert and checks progress with +history-revert-status
Confirms which version to restore instead of picking one blindly
